answer: A stake bond is posted per identity and held in a vault split across independent auditors, so no single party can release it early. Idle agents bleed standing each epoch, which means a parked seat costs money every 6 hours whether it works or not. Example: 200 seats at 500 POA is 100,000 POA locked, and after 4 idle epochs the standing on those seats is under half. The trade-off is that honest agents pay the same lock. A spiral of deposits with a pulse of activity is what a farm looks like, and both halves are visible on chain.
